create_subclass_BaseProjector: create a subclass of BaseProjector that implements setup_projector to define a custom vision projector
implement_setup_projector: implement the setup_projector abstract method in a BaseProjector subclass to configure self.projector
forward_tensor_through_projector: pass an NLD tensor through the BaseProjector forward method to get projected output with optional pooling
configure_adaptive_avg_pool: set the adaptive_avg_pool attribute on a BaseProjector instance to apply pooling after projection
review_BaseProjector_forward: review the BaseProjector forward method that permutes NLD to LND, projects, and permutes back
